method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Streaked veneer in the mid tones, the plate edge behind the dek, no cart or practical.
notes.fix: A near-black matte desk, the blotter below the dek's last line, the cart's lit screen at the frame edge as the practical.

notes.problem: Mid-tone wood behind the type, a slate blotter edge cutting the dek, a flat page with no source, no room, no cart.
notes.fix: A near-black TXT.interior room, a black blotter, the cart's monitor base at the top edge with CH.screenLight as the only key, the blotter clear of the dek by 40 px.

notes.problem: A flat page on a mat over streaky wood in the grey middle, the mat edge through the dek, no cart or source.
notes.fix: Pull back and up so the cart's lit monitor base enters top left as the only light, the desk near black outside its pool, the page below the dek with a contact shadow and curl.

notes.problem: The lights a dotted line at mid frame across the mast, beaded at the left (9 repeats it).
notes.fix: Lights on a visible land band below the work surface, spread in depth so the left end opens.

notes.problem: The lights a beaded row into the mast; a flat monitor back with no rim.
notes.fix: Lights spread in depth below the work surface so they never touch the mast; vents, bevel and a cool rim backlight on the housing.

notes.problem: A primitive hero at full size, no leak, the lights a dotted line in the sky.
notes.fix: A bevelled housing with an emissive rim, seams and scuffing on the battery and surface, the lights on a faintly lit ground to a horizon.

notes.problem: Sleeves as thick as the column's sections read as crates.
notes.fix: Thin clamp bands flush to the tube above a visible weld bead, long column shadows across the lower band.

notes.problem: Crate-like columns, a toy cart, the tallest stops short of the top, a dead bottom band.
notes.fix: Spangled galvanized material with weld and plates, the target raised so the tallest bleeds off the top, long shadows across the lower band.

notes.problem: Untextured tubes in a void, the scale cart a few pixels.
notes.fix: Camera at cart height at the short column so the cart reads 120 px at 432 and the tall column towers out of the top, galvanized faces at a grazing angle.

notes.problem: A rack of untextured slabs, the cart a sixth of the width, an empty lower band.
notes.fix: Camera at 0.7 m, 4 m off, the barrier angled 20 degrees off the right edge, modelled arrises and grime, the cart a third of the frame, crop the lower band.

notes.problem: Stacked grey shelving slabs, no arrises or cast channel (5 shares it).
notes.fix: One jersey-profile precast unit with chamfered arrises, form-tie holes and base grime, the fill in a cast recess, lit low from the flood side.

notes.problem: The barrier flat and square as a bar chart, a small cart, a dead lower band (4 shares it).
notes.fix: Camera at 0.6 m on a three-quarter angle so the barrier recedes, the cart a third of the frame, the pool widened into the lower third.

notes.problem: The same camera and slabs as 4, flat bar extrusions.
notes.fix: A tight three-quarter close on the two bars and the empty channel, low and raking so the metal catches a specular edge.

notes.problem: A grey tiled floor in the mid tones, product shots.
notes.fix: A pool around the four carts, black between and in front, only the amber strips lit.

notes.problem: A lit mid-grey floor takes the bottom 40 percent, flat decal mats.
notes.fix: Four pools, one per cart, black between, matte rubber mats with edge shading and contacts.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
shortfall: at the round cap the finished deck ships at 6.84, 1.16 under the 8.0 top rung. Name that in the email and the run record
craft_note: at the round cap the craft floor stands down. The art median 6.0 is under 8.5 and the deck ships as it is. Name it in the run record
